descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一处位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系边缘的远古空间站。其残留的强烈亚空间信号表明其可能是一个§H星门§!之类的东西——理论上能在类似的空间站间组成网状通路，使舰船能瞬移至星系的不同位置。

假如它真是一个星门的话，现在也因为年久失修而无法使用。不过，如果我们能将其修复，星门拥有者将能激活星系中其他星门，使其能在短短数天穿越极远的距离。
descriptions.en:
An ancient space station of some kind has been located at the edge of the [gateway_system.GetName] system. The strong residual subspace signature that surrounds the station indicates that it may be a "§HGateway§!" of sorts - part of a theoretical network of similar stations that at some point would have allowed for near-instantaneous travel between different parts of the galaxy.

Assuming this is a Gateway, its current state of disrepair has rendered it unusable. If it could be restored into working order, its owner would potentially be able to access any other functional gateways in the galaxy, enabling travel across huge distances in a matter of days.

descriptions.zh: 我们又发现了一个被遗弃的传送门，这次的传送门是在§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系中。和之前的传送门不同，这个传送门并没有被人为改动过且与网络中的其他传送门连接正常。但由于破损严重，此传送门暂时无法使用。
descriptions.en: We have encountered another abandoned Gateway, this time in the §H[gateway_system.GetName]§! system. Unlike the previous one, this Gateway has not been altered in any obvious way and our scans indicate that it is still connected to the rest of the network. However, it is currently inoperable due to its poor condition.

options.script: name = INTRIGUING

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系附近发现了一座远古亚空间传送门。它似乎是一系列相似的星系网络站点的一部分，当它们可运作时，将允许使用者近乎瞬间地从星系的一处转移到另一处。

在其初始建成之后的某个时间点，它与网络的其余部分间的连接被切断了。它现在只能指示出一个有效的目的地——一片位于我们星系外的未经探索的星域，其被我们的天文学家命名为§HL-星团§!。更耐人寻味的是，这座星门完全是由某种未知设计的微型§H纳米机器人§!建造的。

虽然星门散发着微弱的能量特征，但它被故意锁定在某种维护循环中，以防止其被激活。除非我们能设法解除这一过程，不然我们将无法抵达L-星团。
descriptions.en:
We have located what we believe could be an ancient subspace Gateway near §H[gateway_system.GetName]§!. It appears to have been part of a galaxy-wide network of similar stations which, when operational, allowed for near-instantaneous travel from one part of the galaxy to another.

At some point after its initial construction its connection to the rest of the network was severed. It now offers only one valid destination - an uncharted group of stars just beyond our galaxy that our astronomers have designated the §HL-Cluster§!. Even more intriguing, the Gateway was built entirely by microscopic §HNanites§! of an unknown design.

Although the Gateway emits a faint power signature, it has been deliberately locked into some kind of maintenance loop that prevents its activation. Until we find some way of aborting this process, the L-Cluster will remain beyond our reach.

descriptions.zh:
我们又发现了一个被遗弃的传送门，这次的传送门是在§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系附近。此传送门是由我们从没见过的微型§H纳米机器人§!所建。

和之前的传送门不同，此传送门被人进行过大幅度的改动并和传送门网络断开了连接——现在该传送门只能通往一处位于我们星系之外的陌生星域，我们的天文学家将该星域称之为§HL-星团§!。

虽然此传送门有微弱的能源信号，但它被某种维护机制锁住了，因此无法启动。除非我们能设法停止维护机制，否则无法前往L-星团。
descriptions.en:
We have encountered another abandoned Gateway, this time near §H[gateway_system.GetName]§!. It appears to have been built entirely by microscopic §HNanites§! of an unknown design.

Unlike the previous structure, this Gateway has been significantly altered since its initial construction. Its connection to the rest of the network has been severed - instead, the only valid destination is an uncharted group of stars just beyond our galaxy that has been designated the §HL-Cluster§! by our astronomers.

Although the Gateway emits a faint power signature, it has been deliberately locked into some kind of maintenance loop that prevents its activation. Until we find some way of aborting this process, the L-Cluster will remain beyond our reach.

descriptions.zh:
我们在§H[wormhole_system.GetName]§!星系的边缘疑似发现了一个天然形成的亚空间现象！该处的时空出现了裂隙，从而产生了一个"§H虫洞§!"。据[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]推断，此虫洞也许与星系中的其它虫洞通过亚空间相连。

这也就是说，我们的舰船有可能在数日之内就可以由星系的一端到达另一端，这取决于另外的虫洞的位置。不幸的是这个虫洞和大部分虫洞一样，长时间处于不稳定状态。即使有舰船敢接近，也会瞬间被撕成碎片。
descriptions.en:
We have detected what appears to be a naturally occurring subspace phenomenon on the edge of the §H[wormhole_system.GetName]§! system! A rift in the very fabric of space-time has formed here, creating a "§Hwormhole§!" that, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] speculate, may provide a conduit through subspace to another wormhole located somewhere else in our galaxy.

Depending on where the second wormhole is located, this could potentially allow ships to travel from one end of the galaxy to the other in a matter of days. Unfortunately, this wormhole, like the vast majority of its kind, is inherently unstable. Any vessels foolish enough to pass through it would be ripped apart in seconds.

label.zh: 如果我们能将其稳定的话……
label.en: If it could somehow be stabilized...

options.script: name = apoc.5.a

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家已成功恢复了了位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系星门的能源！虽然这装置年代久远，但还是形成了一个完全可通过的亚空间通路。

我们送去的探测器确认，我们激活此星门的行为也为第二座设施提供了能源。现在，这两个连接的星门是我们当前仅有的两个可以使用的设施，但是很可能在别的地方找到其他的处于休眠状态的设施。将来我们甚至能够在选定的星系重新建造全新的星门。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.

The probes we sent through have confirmed that our activation of this Gateway has restored power to a second, identical device. For now, these two linked Gateways are the only ones that are accessible to us, but more inert devices can likely be found elsewhere. In the future, we may even be able to construct entirely new Gateways in systems of our choosing!

descriptions.zh:
我们的科学家已成功恢复了了位于[gateway_system.GetName]星系星门的能源！虽然这装置年代久远，但还是形成了一个完全可通过的亚空间通路。

我们发射的探测器确认此星门与整个网络的连接十分稳定。我们的舰船可以通过它旅行到其他激活的星门，只要星门的拥有者对我们不敌对或是对我们关闭了边境就没问题。
descriptions.en:
Our scientists have successfully restored power to the ancient Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! Despite its age, the device has formed a stable subspace conduit that is fully traversable.

The probes we have sent through confirm that this Gateway has achieved a strong link to the rest of the network. Our ships can now travel through it to other active Gateways, as long as their owners aren't hostile or have closed their borders to us.

descriptions.zh: 位于§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系的被遗弃的传送门突然被激活了！很可能是其他地方的星门将此传送门的能源恢复了，现在此星门已经形成了一个稳定的亚空间回路，应该可以进行传送了。
descriptions.en: The abandoned Gateway in the §H[gateway_system.GetName]§! system has suddenly been reactivated! Power must have been remotely restored to it somehow, possibly from another Gateway. It has formed a stable subspace conduit that appears traversable.

descriptions.zh:
位于§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系的被遗弃的传送门突然被激活了！很可能是其他地方的星门将此传送门的能源恢复了，现在此星门已经形成了一个稳定的亚空间回路，应该可以进行传送了。

但是，我们无法进入星门，星门周围的亚空间力场会推开任何接近的舰船。在我们可以使用这个星门之前，我们必须研究从我们这侧激活星门的方法，这样它才能允许我们的舰船通行。
descriptions.en:
The abandoned Gateway in the §H[gateway_system.GetName]§! system has suddenly been reactivated! Power must have been remotely restored to it somehow, possibly from another Gateway. It has formed a stable subspace conduit that appears traversable.

Unfortunately, the Gateway does not allow us access. The subspace field surrounding the device pushes our ships away whenever they approach. Before we can make use of it, we will have to research some way of activating the Gateway from our side so that it allows our ships to pass.

label.zh: 随时都可能有东西从那里出来！
label.en: Something might come through at any time!

descriptions.zh: 我们在[gateway_system.GetName]恒星系完成了我们第一个可以投入使用的星门，这可以被称为是科技和工程的大胜利！星门已形成了稳定的亚空间通路并与星系的其他星门网络成功建立了链接。
descriptions.en: In what can only be described as a triumph of science and engineering, we have finished construction of our first operational Gateway in the [gateway_system.GetName] system! The device has formed a stable subspace conduit and established a successful link with the rest of the galaxy's Gateway network.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 我们在§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系内发现的星门已经恢复供电。它已与星门网络其他部分建立连接，处于正常运转状态。
descriptions.en: Power has been restored to the derelict Gateway that was found in the §H[gateway_system.GetName]§! system. It has been connected to the rest of the Gateway network and is now fully operational.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: 位于§H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系内的新星门已经建造完毕。它已与其余传送门网络建立稳定的亚空间连接，并且正常运转。
descriptions.en: Construction has concluded on the new Gateway in the §H[gateway_system.GetName]§! system. A stable subspace connection to the rest of the Gateway network has been established, and it is now fully operational.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT

descriptions.zh: §H[gateway_system.GetName]§!星系中为建造星门而准备的深空建造基址已经准备就绪。一旦我们的必要资源准备完毕，星门的正式建造随时都可以动工。
descriptions.en: The deep space construction site for the planned Gateway in the §H[gateway_system.GetName]§! system is now in place. Once we have the necessary resources, construction of the actual Gateway may commence at any time.

options.script: name = GOOD

descriptions.zh: 以剑与火，燃异端之地。以彼之烬，沃泱泱星河。
descriptions.en: By sword and flame shall heretical worlds burn, and with their ashes shall the galaxy be salted.

descriptions.zh:
大气层，生物群落，重力——虽然很便利——但只有可憎的血肉之躯才真正需要它们。

摧毁这颗星球，摧毁这些有机体。
descriptions.en:
Atmospheres, biotopes, gravity - while frequently convenient - are only truly needed by the detestable meatbags.

Kill the planet, kill the organic.

descriptions.zh:
随着威慑理论再次在[Root.Capital.GetName]上的政府学者们之间流行，巨像计划被认为是终极的威慑力量；这是一种甚至超越了泰坦级舰船的武器。尽管计划中的巨像可以携带完全摧毁整颗星球的武器，我们却希望能以更温和，但永久性的方式解决争端。

假设敌人不愿停止对我们或是我们盟友的进攻，那我们就只好§R强迫他们停手§!。
descriptions.en:
With deterrence theory once again in vogue among leading political scientists on [Root.Capital.GetName], the Colossus Project is presented as the ultimate deterrent; a weapon to surpass even the Titan ship class. While the proposed Colossus ships could carry payloads capable of complete planetary annihilation, we will deploy them using a less violent - but nevertheless terrifyingly permanent - method of conflict resolution.

If a hypothetical enemy will not cease their aggression toward us or our allies, we must simply §Rmake them§!.

descriptions.zh:
原本遮遮掩掩，而更早之前只在军工厂最隐蔽的角落里才被悄声提及的巨像计划，现在已经正式对外公布。这很可能是全星系史上最伟大的军事发明——巨像计划包含了开发§R歼星级§!武器平台，以及携带它的巨像舰体。因为除了计划中的行星终结者武器，容不下其它任何武装，巨像很可能需要护航，

无论如何，一旦巨像成功部署，将会成为星系中最具破坏性的力量。
descriptions.en:
Previously spoken of only in hushed voices, and before then only in whispers in the most labyrinthine corridors of military skunkworks facilities, the Colossus Project now enjoys official sanction. Possibly the single greatest military innovation the galaxy will ever see, the Colossus Project comprises the development of a §RPlanet-Killer§! weapons platform as well as a Colossus hull configuration to carry it. The Colossus vessels will likely require an escort as the projected demands of a Planet-Killer weapon preclude any other armament.

Nevertheless, the Colossus, once developed, promises to be perhaps the single most destructive force in the galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 巨像计划被誉为与荼毒星系的邪恶异星杂种们斗争中最重要的发明。正如设计的那样，巨像是一艘搭载着一门§R歼星级§!武器的重甲巨舰。因为异星杂种的威胁远未结束，它那能够轻易消灭星系中不愿屈服于我们的星球的能力，对我们来说必定将是无价之宝。
descriptions.en: The Colossus Project is being hailed as the single most important advancement in the ongoing struggle against the wretched aliens that plague the galaxy. As designed, a Colossus ship is a gargantuan, heavily armored frame fitted with a lone §RPlanet-Killer§!-class weapon. Its ability to simply wipe the galaxy clean of planets that will not submit to us will certainly prove invaluable, as the xeno threat is far from over.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]将会研发制造出星系中有史以来最大的舰体结构，并为其设计一个能摧毁整颗行星武器。
descriptions.en: Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] will engineer one of the largest hull configurations the galaxy has ever known, and devise for it a weapon capable of devastating entire worlds.

titles.en: The Gun Pointed at the Head of the Universe

descriptions.zh: 各个领域的著名科学家们终于一起敲定了装备在首批巨像级舰船上的§R歼星级§!武器的最终设计方案。我们能从中选择一种以完成巨像计划的最终阶段。
descriptions.en: Leading scientists across all conceivable fields have at last finalized their proposals for the §RPlanet-Killer§!-class weapon that will arm our first Colossus-type ships. We may select one proposal to develop alongside the final stages of the Colossus Project.

descriptions.zh:
现有的空闲处理循环确认足以开发一（1）种§R歼星级§!武器以适配§G巨像计划§!的竣工。

需要授权优先级。
descriptions.en:
Spare processing cycles have been estimated and deemed sufficient to develop one (1) §RPlanet-Killer§!-class weapon to coincide with completion of §GColossus Project§!.

Prioritization needed.

descriptions.zh: 经过大量的试验，我们终于有能力研发出一套可以适配首批巨像级舰船的§R歼星级§!武器。其他的项目可以暂时被搁置，眼下我们只能将全部资源用于开发此武器，以便赶上巨像计划的收尾阶段。
descriptions.en: We have explored myriad possibilities, and it is now clear to us that we can develop a suitable §RPlanet-Killer§!-class weapon for our very first Colossus-type vessels. While other avenues can be pursued later, we can only spare the attention to develop one such weapon alongside the final stages of the Colossus Project.

tooltips.zh:
§R歼星级武器§!：
§L发射的热能流能够加热行星大气，并引爆行星核心，此举将彻底的毁灭星球的地壳构造。最后，一个相对较小的冲击波会将行星炸得四分五裂。§!
tooltips.en:
§RPlanet-Killer Weapon§!:
§LA directed feed of thermic energy superheats the atmosphere and agitates the planet's core, setting up disastrous tectonic events. A final and comparatively minute concussive blast is then delivered, cracking the planet open.§!

tooltips.zh:
§R歼星级武器§!：
§L一个永久的、不可逾越的屏蔽场将被部署在行星表面（吸收一些波长的光）。§!
tooltips.en:
§RPlanet-Killer Weapon§!:
§LA shielding field is deployed around a planet, creating a barrier that is permanent and impenetrable (save for some wavelengths of light).§!

tooltips.zh:
§R歼星级武器§!：
§L一种加速的中子辐射羽流将会扫过行星表面，并对大多数生物组织进行破坏。§!
tooltips.en:
§RPlanet-Killer Weapon§!:
§LAn accelerated plume of neutron radiation "paints" the planet surface, severely degrading most materials and directly destroying biological tissue.§!

tooltips.zh:
§R歼星级武器§!：
§L一个灵能投射器将圣洁真理投放到行星上，使所有有信仰的人成为正信者并消灭那些没有信仰的人。§!
tooltips.en:
§RPlanet-Killer Weapon§!:
§LA psionic projector shines divine truth upon the world to make true believers out of all who are capable of belief, and annihilating those who are not.§!

tooltips.zh:
§R歼星级武器§!：
§L向大气中散布大量纳米机器人，它们侵入智慧生命并将自己转化为控制性的植入体，最终将不知情的宿主转化为被机械智能控制的义体人。§!
tooltips.en:
§RPlanet-Killer Weapon§!:
§LSwarms of nanobots are dispersed in the atmosphere. They infect sapient beings and restructure themselves into cybernetic implants, turning their unwitting hosts into cyborgs slaved to the Machine Intelligence.§!

tooltips.zh:
§R歼星级武器§!：
§L这是一种巨像级心智抹除武器，可以释放覆盖整颗行星的能量波，将大多数感性生命变回未开智状态。我们估计在进行进一步调整之后，它甚至还可以用来抹除机器单元的记忆体使其瘫痪。§!
tooltips.en:
§RPlanet-Killer Weapon§!:
§LA colossal mind-wiping cannon which unleashes a planet-wide wave of energy, returning most sentient life to a pre-sapient state. We estimate that with additional tuning, it might also be used to wipe clean memory banks and disable robotic units.§!

tooltips.zh:
§R歼星级武器§!：
§L熔炉将灼热的能量束聚焦于行星地幔，破坏其核心稳定性，引发构造混乱，令地表极度不稳定。§!
tooltips.en:
§RPlanet-Killer Weapon§!:
§LFocusing a searing energy beam into the planet's mantle, the Smelter destabilizes its core, triggering tectonic chaos and rendering the surface violently unstable.§!

descriptions.zh: 巨像计划——设计[Root.GetAdj]历史上最大武器平台、并搭载一门§R[Root.Get1stPlanetKiller]§!的里程碑式任务，已经取得成果，并且接近尾声。
descriptions.en: The Colossus Project, the monumental task of designing the biggest weapons platform in [Root.GetAdj] history and a §R[Root.Get1stPlanetKiller]§! to arm it with, has yielded results and drawn to a close.

descriptions.zh:
巨像计划已完成。

新舰船类型可用：
<<§G巨像§!>>

新武器部件可用：
<<§R[Root.Get1stPlanetKiller]§!>>
descriptions.en:
Colossus Project completed.

New hull configuration available:
<<§GColossus§!>>

New weapon component available:
<<§R[Root.Get1stPlanetKiller]§!>>

descriptions.zh: 我们已经完全掌握了巨像的构造，并且可以组装。而且，虽然不易，我们意识到梦魇般的§R[Root.Get1stPlanetKiller]§!也是可以被驾驭的。
descriptions.en: The Colossus configuration has fully formed in our mind, ready to be assembled. And, with some unease, we realize that the §R[Root.Get1stPlanetKiller]§! nightmare can also be made manifest.

descriptions.zh: 我们收到消息说，[From.GetName]已经开发出了巨像——这是一种能完全毁灭行星的武器平台。
descriptions.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has developed specifications for a Colossus-type hull configuration, a weapon platform potentially capable of complete planetary destruction.
